workspaces.description: Zapfmeisters Desktop is a full featured desktop environment that includes a web browser, file manager, terminal, and office suite. It is designed to provide a familiar and user-friendly interface for users who need a complete desktop experience within a containerized environment.

Obsidian is a flexible and open app that lets you store, link, and publish your notes on any device. You can shape Obsidian with plugins, themes, and a graph view to spark your thinking and organize your knowledge.
